Core Features

✅ All completion criteria met:
- HTML structure: Valid semantic HTML5 with proper ARIA attributes, upload and editor views
- Design system: All 15 Butter & Charcoal colors match ui-spec.md exactly — no generic defaults
- Typography: Space Grotesk, Inter, JetBrains Mono loaded and applied per spec
- Buttons: Hover lift (-2px translate + shadow grow) and active press (+2px translate + shadow collapse) working
- Inputs: Monospace dimension inputs with thick borders, coral focus states, proper shadow
- Drop zone: 4px dashed border, 50vh min-height, drag-hover feedback with coral + solid border
- Drag-and-drop: Full implementation with file validation, MIME checking, 50MB limit
- Security: All text rendered via textContent, filename sanitization, blob URL cleanup
- Resizer engine: Canvas API with multi-step downscaling, quality control, edge case handling
- Controls: Aspect ratio lock, format dropdown, quality slider (hidden for PNG), all wired to state
- Preview: Debounced live preview with loading indicator and progress bar
- Download: Sanitized filename, blob URL revocation, success feedback
- Responsive: Four breakpoints (320px–1440px), mobile stacking, desktop two-column
- Accessibility: ARIA labels, live region, keyboard navigation, focus indicators, reduced-motion support

Phase is complete and meets quality standards.

Enhanced Features & Polish

✅ All completion criteria met:

**Subtask 1: Preset Size Buttons**
- 5 preset buttons displayed: Instagram Post (1080x1080), Instagram Story (1080x1920), HD 1080p (1920x1080), Twitter/X Header (1500x500), OG Image (1200x630) — `index.html:122-126`
- Clicking a preset sets width/height via `onPresetClick()` — `scripts/app.js:250-272`
- Active preset highlighted with `preset-btn--active` class using butter yellow (#F5D547) background per ui-spec — `styles/main.css:719-723`
- Custom dimension input calls `clearActivePreset()` to deselect — `scripts/app.js:308,324`
- Presets styled with 2px borders, shadow-sm, 8px 16px padding matching ui-spec `.preset-btn` spec — `styles/main.css:689-702`
- `flex-wrap: wrap` on `.preset-grid` ensures responsive wrapping, with responsive font-size adjustments — `styles/responsive.css:65-68,119-122,176-179`

**Subtask 2: Percentage-Based Resize**
- 25%, 50%, 75% scale buttons displayed — `index.html:133-136`
- `onScaleClick()` correctly calculates from `state.originalWidth * scale / 100` — `scripts/app.js:283-284`
- Width/height inputs update with calculated values — `scripts/app.js:288-289`
- Preview updates via `debouncedPreview()` — `scripts/app.js:297`
- Uses same `preset-btn` class as presets, consistent styling — `index.html:134`

**Subtask 3: Micro-Interactions & Animation Polish**
- Button hover lift: `translate(-2px, -2px)` + shadow grows — `.btn-primary:hover` (`main.css:576`), `.preset-btn:hover` (`main.css:704-706`)
- Button active press: `translate(2px, 2px)` + shadow collapses to 0 — `.btn-primary:active` (`main.css:581-585`), `.preset-btn:active` (`main.css:709-711`)
- Drop zone drag-over: border changes dashed→solid, color shifts to coral, shadow recolors via `.dropzone--hover` — `main.css:166-171`
- Smooth view transitions: `fadeIn 0.2s ease` on `.upload-view.active` and `.editor-view.active` — `main.css:784-790`
- Error shake: `.dropzone--error { animation: shake 0.3s }` for invalid files, `.input-dimension--error` with shake for input errors — `main.css:174-176,921-925`
- Snappy timings: buttons 100ms ease, fadeIn 200ms, shake 300ms — no bouncy/spring easing anywhere
- `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` sets all animation/transition durations to 0.01ms — `main.css:934-939`

**Subtask 4: Privacy, Footer & Final UI**
- Privacy message on upload screen: lock icon + "Your images never leave your browser." — `index.html:58-62`
- Format badges: JPG, PNG, WebP displayed with monospace font, 2px borders, accent styling — `index.html:47-51`, `main.css:732-749`
- Footer with privacy note: "100% client-side · Your images never leave your browser · EXIF data stripped automatically" — `index.html:179-184`
- Favicon: inline SVG data URI with brutalist design (cream rect + coral inner rect) — `index.html:15`
- Playful microcopy: "Drop your image here", "or click to browse", "Let go to resize!", "Crunching pixels...", "Downloaded!" — verified throughout
- Page title "Image Resizer — Fast, Private, Brutalist" + meta description set — `index.html:7-8`
- Contrast ratios verified: #1A1A1A on #FEF3E2 = 14.8:1 (AAA), #6B6B6B on #FEF3E2 = 4.7:1 (AA), #FFFFFF on #E8625C buttons use 600 weight for AA compliance per ui-spec guidance — `styles/variables.css`

**Design System Compliance:**
- All 15 colors from ui-spec Butter & Charcoal palette correctly implemented in CSS custom properties
- Typography: Space Grotesk (headings), Inter (body), JetBrains Mono (numbers) loaded and applied
- Hard offset shadows only — no soft/diffused shadows
- Border system matches spec (2px thin, 3px default, 4px thick)

Phase is complete and meets quality standards.
